_readme: SAFE MINIMAL DEFAULTS after day-1 crash on the wide-hook run.
Only hooks whose targets are cold during the season are enabled.
The year-end promotion/relegation installers, the stadium
transaction, and the year-end news publisher never fire on a
normal day — they only run at the season boundary — so they
cost approximately zero while ticking through the season and
then wake up at year-end. Add hooks back one group at a time
once the safe run completes cleanly.
`va` is the GDI VA. `dd_va_hint` records the DirectDraw
equivalent for cross-reference — the GDI delta is NON-UNIFORM
so it CANNOT be a fixed offset. Every dd_va_hint entry needs a
live confirmation of the corresponding gdi va before enabling.
Excluded from the safe run:
Group B (fixture pipeline) — hot on any day the season is
regenerated; crashed the day-1 run. Add back AFTER a
successful minimal capture, one hook at a time.
Group A hooks whose targets fire per-club-per-day (status
stamper, P/R swap, person walks, pyramid orch,
Conference coordinator) — the pyramid orch VA is also
unverified (memory notes it as inferred).
Groups C/D/E/F — DirectDraw VAs, need GDI resolution first.
